entry.title: R&SVP - Hio Ridge - From Old Barn and Ell sitting on a few rocks to a stunning barn venue

media:group.media:title: R&SVP - Hio Ridge - From Old Barn and Ell sitting on a few rocks to a stunning barn venue
media:group.media:description: It has been a fun challenge to take a 200+ year old house, barn and ell that had been in the family for 4 generations and turn it into a stunning event space. We repurposed everything possible. The original windows now provide natural lighting in the barn. The original exterior barn boards now line the interior of the barn. The ell has been converted into beautiful spaces for the bride and groom and their parties to get ready for their big day! Stay tuned for more reels showing the transformation.
